phase_name: Author the fresh-shell / fresh-subprocess mint regression suite

objectives.description: Create test-mint-dispatch-seq.sh modelled on test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh structure
Emit [INFO] line naming the resolved skill-base.sh path
Case A (fresh shell), Case B (repeat call), Case C (poisoned ambient), Case D (separate subprocess), Case E (budget-continuation continuity), Case F (missing-field tolerance)
Red-demonstration against scratch pre-fix function body before phase closes
Run new suite; confirm all cases pass, exit 0
objectives.note: Verified via a scratch copy pointing directly at the source-store skill-base.sh (14/14 pass, exit 0). The real committed suite's deploy-tree-first resolution currently still resolves the STALE, unfixed .claude/scripts/skill-base.sh (deploy deliberately withheld this cycle per delegation-context safety constraint -- a live /orchestrate loop depends on the deployed copy mid-flight). Running the committed suite as-is right now would report expected failures against that stale copy, not a suite defect. Deferred to the operator's own deploy; see Phase 3 deviation.

findings.logic_verification: Scratch copy of the suite, with resolve_candidate's deploy-tree candidate forced to a nonexistent path so it falls through to the source-store skill-base.sh directly, ran all 14 assertions across cases A-F: 14 passed, 0 failed, exit 0.
findings.red_demonstration: A scratch shim file (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/ NOT touched; scratch file lived only under the session scratchpad, never committed and never used to revert the repo) reconstructed the exact pre-fix skill_orchestrate_mint_dispatch_seq body verbatim from git show HEAD~1. Running the suite's case logic against it: 2 passed (contamination guard, and Case E's sibling-field check, which is independent of the defect), 12 FAILED, exit 1. Notably Case C (poisoned ambient=99, guard=5) returned 100 instead of 6, and Case D's two independent subprocess calls both returned 1 instead of 11/12 -- the precise multi-shell defect this task fixes. Several cases additionally hard-errored with 'unbound variable' under the suite's own `set -u`, an even stronger failure mode than the silently-wrong-value case the defect report described.
